text:
WEIERSTRASS ELLIPTIC AND RELATED FUNCTIONS (p.633)
18.3. Special Values and Relations
Values at Periods
\wp, \wp', and \zeta are infinite, \sigma is zero at z=2\omega_i, i=1,2,3 and at 2\omega_2'(\Delta<0).
Two sub-columns below, \Delta>0 (left) and \Delta<0 (right):
Half-Periods
18.3.1  \wp(\omega_i)=e_i (i=1,2,3)   (single statement, spans both sub-columns)
18.3.2  \wp'(\omega_i)=0 (i=1,2,3)   (single statement, spans both sub-columns)
18.3.3  \eta_i=\zeta(\omega_i) (i=1,2,3)   (single statement, spans both sub-columns)
18.3.4  \eta_1=\eta,\ \eta_2=\eta+\eta',\ \eta_3=\eta'   (single statement, spans both sub-columns)
18.3.5  H_i^2=2e_i^2+e_je_k\ (i,j,k=1,2,3;\ i\neq j,\ i\neq k,\ j\neq k)   (single statement, spans both sub-columns)
18.3.6  =(e_i-e_j)(e_i-e_k)=2e_i^2+\frac{g_3}{4e_i}=3e_i^2-\frac{g_2}{4}   (single statement, spans both sub-columns)
18.3.7  [\Delta>0] e_i real   |   [\Delta<0] e_2 real and non-negative
18.3.8  [\Delta>0] e_1>0\geq e_2>e_3 (equality when g_3=0)   |   [\Delta<0] (e_2=0 when g_3=0); e_1=-\alpha+i\beta,\ e_3=\bar e_1 where \alpha\geq0,\ \beta>0 (equality when g_3=0)
18.3.9  [\Delta>0] \eta>0   |   [\Delta<0] \eta_2'=\zeta(\omega_2')=\eta'-\eta
18.3.10  [\Delta>0] \eta'/i \lessgtr 0 if (continues into 18.3.11's left column)   |   [\Delta<0] \eta_2>0
18.3.11  [\Delta>0] |\omega'|/\omega \gtrless 1.91014\,050\text{ (approx.)}  -- i.e. together with 18.3.10: \eta'/i\le0 if |\omega'|/\omega\ge1.91014050, and \eta'/i\ge0 if |\omega'|/\omega\le1.91014050   |   [\Delta<0] \eta_2'/i \lessgtr 0 if |\omega_2'|/\omega_2 \gtrless 3.81915\,447\text{ (approx.)}
18.3.12  [\Delta>0] H_1>0,\ H_3>0   |   [\Delta<0] H_2>0
18.3.13  [\Delta>0] H_2\equiv i\sqrt{-H_2^2}   |   [\Delta<0] \pi/4<\arg(H_3)\le\pi/2\text{ (equality if }g_3=0\text{)};\ H_1=\bar H_3
18.3.14  [\Delta>0] \sigma(\omega)=e^{\eta\omega/2}/H_1^{1/2}   |   [\Delta<0] \sigma(\omega_2)=e^{\eta_2\omega_2/2}/H_2^{1/2}
18.3.15  [\Delta>0] \sigma(\omega')=ie^{\eta'\omega'/2}/H_3^{1/2}   |   [\Delta<0] \sigma(\omega_2')=ie^{\eta_2'\omega_2'/2}/H_2^{1/2}
18.3.16  [\Delta>0] \sigma^2(\omega_2)=e^{\eta_2\omega_2}/(-H_2)   |   [\Delta<0] \sigma^2(\omega')=e^{\eta'\omega'}/(-H_3)
18.3.17  [\Delta>0] \arg[\sigma(\omega_2)]=\frac{\eta'\omega}{i}+\frac{\pi}{2}   |   [\Delta<0] \arg[\sigma(\omega')]=\frac{\eta_2'\omega_2}{4i}+\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac12\arg(e_2+H_2-e_1)
Quarter Periods
18.3.18  [\Delta>0] \wp(\omega/2)=e_1+H_1>e_1   |   [\Delta<0] \wp(\omega_2/2)=e_2+H_2>e_2
18.3.19  [\Delta>0] \wp'(\omega/2)=-2H_1\sqrt{2H_1+3e_1}   |   [\Delta<0] \wp'(\omega_2/2)=-2H_2\sqrt{2H_2+3e_2}
18.3.20  [\Delta>0] \zeta(\omega/2)=\frac12[\eta+\sqrt{2H_1+3e_1}]   |   [\Delta<0] \zeta(\omega_2/2)=\frac12[\eta_2+\sqrt{2H_2+3e_2}]
note: Re-transcribed from scratch against the 300dpi scan (own vision). Dense two-sub-column page (\Delta>0 vs \Delta<0), formulas 18.3.1-18.3.20; 18.3.1-18.3.6 are single statements printed once, centered, spanning both sub-columns (not duplicated), so encoded as one line each rather than a [\Delta>0]|[\Delta<0] pair. 18.3.10/18.3.11 (left sub-column) use a stacked \le-over-\ge glyph pairing two conditional cases on one glyph -- verified at 2x zoom -- transcribed as \lessgtr/\gtrless with the paired meaning spelled out in the 18.3.11 line since the two numbered lines form one logical conditional statement split across the page's print layout. 18.3.17's final subscript (\Delta<0 side) was verified at 2x zoom as e_1, matching the pattern of e_1/e_2/e_3 established earlier on the page. The previous Step 23 push for this page was uncorrected Nougat output that renders \wp as a literal '*/*' and drops most equation numbers/subscripts -- unusable, discarded in favor of direct transcription.
